option.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?> <?import javafx.scene.text.*?>
<VBox xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx/11.0.1" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml/1" fx:controller="org.example.controller.AccueilController" styleClass="root"> <children> <!-- Navbar Container --> <VBox styleClass="navbar-container"> <HBox styleClass="navbar"> <!-- Logo --> <Label text="CuraVita" styleClass="logo"/>
<!-- Spacer between logo and menu --> <Region HBox.hgrow="SOMETIMES"/>
<!-- Menu Items --> <Button text="Accueil" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="Produits" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="Commandes" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="Ordonnance" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="Traitement" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="Guide Santé" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="Contact" styleClass="nav-item"/> <Button text="À propos" styleClass="nav-item"/>
<!-- Spacer to push right elements to end --> <Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/>
<!-- Search and Profile --> <TextField fx:id="searchField" promptText="Rechercher..." styleClass="search-field"/> <Button fx:id="searchButton" text="" styleClass="nav-icon-button"/> <Button fx:id="profileButton" text="" styleClass="nav-icon-button" onAction="#toggleProfileDropdown"/> <VBox fx:id="profileDropdown" styleClass="profile-dropdown" visible="false" managed="false"> <Button text="Profil" styleClass="dropdown-item"/> <Button text="Dashboard" onAction="#goToDashboard" styleClass="dropdown-item"/> <Button text="Logout" styleClass="dropdown-item"/> </VBox> </HBox> </HBox> </VBox>
<!-- Hero Section (Minimal) --> <VBox styleClass="hero-section" VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS"> <Label text="Bienvenue sur CuraVita" styleClass="hero-title"/> <Label text="Votre solution moderne pour la gestion de pharmacie" styleClass="hero-subtitle"/> </VBox> </children> </VBox>
